$jsonSchema.title: Dish Schema
$jsonSchema.description: Validation schema for the dish collection - individual dishes from menus or AI recommendations

ai_recommendation_id.description: Reference to ai_recommendation._id - which recommendation this dish belongs to

description.description: Detailed description of the dish from menu or AI
examples: Creamy pasta with pancetta, egg, and Pecorino Romano

classification.description: Whether dish is familiar to user (has tried before) or new to try

reason.description: Why this dish is classified/recommended - AI explanation for classification
examples: Contains your liked flavor profile (spicy, umami)

section.description: Menu section this dish belongs to
